title: KITE state Location Map table served under the 2026 portal, seven undated venue/use rows
issuer: KITE / Kerala School Sasthrolsavam state portal
review_scope: Received HTML text, links and table structure read directly; all seven venue/use rows inspected. No browser-render review and no independent inspection of the linked Google Maps destinations.
notes: The Location Map table served under the 2026 state portal lists seven venue/use rows: MES HSS Olavakkode, Palakkad / Mathematics Fair; Kanikkamatha HSS, Palakkad / IT Fair; Big Bazar HSS, Palakkad / Social Science Fair; BM HSS, Palakkad / Science Fair; BEM HSS, Palakkad / Work Experience Fair; Small Kotta Maithanam Palakkad / VHSE Expo (Exhibition); St.Sebastian's S B School / VHSE Expo (On The Spot). The table has no issue date or independent event-year statement. Preserve these literal rows without assigning a proved different edition, treating a 2026 URL/HTML title as the table publication date, or calling this a recovered final Mannarkkad allocation. Programme PDF still returned 404 during the same bounded check. The current DGE notice search supplied no new final allocation, organising appointment, Working Model clarification or national delegation order.
evidence_limits: Undated displayed table, not a signed venue-allocation order, final Mannarkkad programme or current local entry instruction.
Linked Google Maps short URLs are retained as source links; their destination contents were not independently reviewed.
No historical edition is inferred from the place names alone.
